results.name: dashboard: spend by department
results.plan: Index Only Scan on requisitions (idx_requisitions_approved_spend) → Seq Scan on departments
results.sql: SELECT departments.name, sum(total_amount) FROM "requisitions" INNER JOIN "departments" ON "departments"."company_id" = 1 AND "departments"."id" = "requisitions"."department_id" WHERE "requisitions"."company_id" = 1 AND "requisitions"."status" IN ('approved', 'ordered') AND "requisitions"."approved_at" >= '2026-08-08 07:02:48.384443' GROUP BY "departments"."name"

results.name: po finder: supplier candidates
results.plan: Sort → Bitmap Heap Scan on purchase_orders → Bitmap Index Scan (idx_purchase_orders_supplier_status)
